description: What one connected account has posted lately, read from the network itself: each post’s words, when it went out, what kind it is and its link, with likes and comments where the network gives them. Read it during setup to hear how the business already writes, and before a new set of posts so nothing is said twice. Works for Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook Pages and Threads; for other networks read the account’s public page yourself. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

limit.description: How many posts to read, newest first, from 1 to 25. Ten when left out.

name: posts_recent
title: Recent posts on an account
